newsitem.title: INDIA: India government likely by April 21 - United Front.
newsitem.headline: India government likely by April 21 - United Front.

text.p: India's United Front coalition expects to form a new centre-left government with the support of the Congress party before parliament reconvenes on April 21, a spokesman said on Friday.
"The formation of a new government is entirely likely before the parliament resumes on the 21st," coalition spokesman Jaipal Reddy told reporters in the Indian capital.

Speaking after a special meeting of the United Front's decision-making Steering Committee, Reddy said the coalition's leaders had accepted a Congress letter of support earlier on Friday as satisfactory.

"The standing committee, after reviewing the letter and noting the content, found it quite satisfactory and therefore decided to go ahead with the process of choosing a new leader for United Front through consensus," Reddy said.

"We hope to complete the process by tonight or latest by tomorrow," Reddy said, adding that the United Front expected to establish an "institutional mechanism" for coordinating relations with Congress.

Congress president Sitaram Kesri told President Shankar Dayal Sharma in his letter of support for the United Front that if the coalition was unable to find a new leader, his own March 31 claim to form a government to succeed caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda would still stand.
